subject: Solstice renewal: ops/legal alignment + QBR booking
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@solstice.ai>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@solstice.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Solstice Procurement <procurement@solstice.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice renewal: ops/legal alignment + QBR booking

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As discussed, we want to kick off the renewal + uplift discussion early so we can lock capacity, confirm term/price tradeoffs, and get Legal/Procurement time to finish any redlines before the committed term starts.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (Solstice_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) and the most recent invoice for reference. High-level proposal and asks below:

- Timeline (target):
  - Confirm commercial term and target uplift by 05/28
  - Legal review and DocuSign routing completed by 06/11
  - QBR to align execs and finalize rollout the week of 06/15
- Immediate asks for Solstice:
  1) Confirm who from Procurement will own the legal packet and expected turnaround (cc'd procurement).
  2) Pick 2x QBR slots (I attached QBR_proposed_slots.ics) — we suggested 06/16 AM or 06/18 PM.
  3) Share any new expected throughput/peak windows for next 12 months so we can size Dedicated capacity options.
- Redwood commitments:
  - I'll own the M.A.P. and scheduling, Ben will lead legal and SOW redlines, Grace will scope capacity/staffing runway.

If that timeline works, we'll kick off a short internal sync and then route the M.A.P. for signatures.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0147

Attachments: Solstice_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, current_invoice_Mar2026.pdf, QBR_proposed_slots.ics

---

From: Elena Soto <elena@solstice.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@solstice.ai>, Solstice Procurement <procurement@solstice.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice renewal: ops/legal alignment + QBR booking

Thanks Stephanie — this looks good and appreciate the clear timeline. A few quick notes:

- Procurement: forwarding to our procurement inbox (procurement@solstice.ai) — they should be able to start formal review but may need the final SOW before routing. Marcus will own the uplift numbers and capacity inputs.
- QBR slots: 06/16 AM is good for our execs; 06/18 PM is also okay as a fallback. Please pencil 06/16 9:00–10:00 PT.
- Throughput: we're ramping a new batch inference workload in August that will add ~35% peak token/sec in Sept–Nov. I'll send a short traffic forecast this afternoon.

Elena Soto
VP Product, Solstice AI
elena@solstice.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700

Quick internal note — I've started a legal packet draft and expect our standard term amendment to be ready for an initial redline by 05/21. Two potential items to flag for Solstice so we can expedite:

- Data residency clause: Solstice's account currently uses multi-region backups; if they require region locking we'll need a short lead time to validate our migration path.
- SLA uplift: if they want a tighter SLO we should lock committed capacity (Dedicated) to avoid rolling fallback.

I'll include annotated change-log in the draft and drop it into the Drive link (HS-123456789) so Elena/Procurement can comment.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice renewal: ops/legal alignment + QBR booking

Perfect — thanks for the quick responses.

Action items (assignments):
- Solstice / Marcus: send the traffic forecast and confirm preferred term length (12 vs 24 months) by 05/20.
- Procurement: confirm the legal owner and expected SLA for routing by 05/20.
- Ben: aim to share first redline 05/21 and leave comments on HS-123456789.
- Grace: start capacity sketch for +35% peak and share a cost delta by 05/24.

I've penciled the QBR for 06/16 9:00–10:00 PT and sent the calendar invite. If anything changes, please flag here and we'll rebook. Looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Stephanie
